sale only |} ==Multi-movie releases== ===Pikachu the Movie Box 1998-2002=== ===Pikachu the Movie Box 2003-2006=== ===Pikachu the Movie Box 2007-2010=== ===Pikachu the Movie Premium Box 1998-2010=== This set was released exclusively on Blu-ray on November 28, 2012. This fourteen disc set contains high-definition remasters of the first thirteen Pokémon movies, as well as the first, second, fourth, and fifth Pikachu shorts: the third short, ''Pichu & Pikachu'' was not included due to the arrest of Sakai Noriko in 2009. ===ExtremeSpeed Genesect: Mewtwo Awakens - Mewtwo Special Pack=== Released alongside the singular DVD and Blu-ray versions of ''ExtremeSpeed Genesect: Mewtwo Awakens'', this three-disc DVD set features the aformentioned movie, alongside ''Mewtwo - Prologue to its Awakening'', ''Mewtwo Strikes Back'' and ''Pikachu's Summer Vacation'', ''[[Mewtwo Returns|Mewtwo! I Am Here!]]'', and the ''[[Pokémon the Series]]'' episode ''[[EP063|Tokiwa Gym!
